description: Policy-driven dependency updates for Verixa. Grouped per workspace on a weekly schedule with semver-aware strategies (see docs/guides/ci-cd.md, 'Dependency updates').

packageRules.description: Group every workspace's non-major updates into one PR so a dependency change is never scattered across unrelated diffs.
prBodyNotes: Scoped, policy-driven updates come from renovate.json. Patch and minor bumps are grouped per workspace with a Conventional Commit title that passes commitlint (docs/guides/conventional-commits.md). Major bumps are opened separately below so a review of a breaking change is not hidden inside a patch/minor PR.

packageRules.description: Major-version bumps are reviewed separately from patch/minor so a breaking change is one PR and the supporting lockfile sync is not mixed with it.
prBodyNotes: Major-version bumps are opened separately from patch/minor so review visibility is not lost. The lockfile stays in the same PR as the manifest change; the CI lockfile gate (lockfile-check.yml) verifies pnpm-lock.yaml is committed and in sync before the upgrade merges.

packageRules.description: Workspace-aware updates stay scoped to the package that declares them, and never leak into an unrelated workspace.
